# 9nth Dimension

> The parts of the Bible most churches skip: lost texts, prophecy, Old Testament mysteries and how the canon was formed, told straight, with the references, so you can go deeper in your faith.

## The Spiritual Ladder

- [Rung 1: Awakening — when you sense there is more](https://9nthdimension.com/ladder/awakening/): The first stage of spiritual growth is a quiet restlessness. Learn the signs of spiritual awakening, what is happening, and how to take your first real step.
- [Rung 2: Foundations — prayer, gratitude and stillness as daily habits](https://9nthdimension.com/ladder/foundations/): Spiritual growth needs a foundation of small daily habits. Learn how to build a simple prayer, gratitude and stillness routine that actually lasts.
- [Rung 3: Practice — faith in action through intention and discipline](https://9nthdimension.com/ladder/practice/): The third stage of spiritual growth is living your faith, not just studying it. Learn how intention, discipline and consistency turn belief into a changed life.
- [Rung 4: Healing — forgiveness, inner work and discernment](https://9nthdimension.com/ladder/healing/): The fourth stage of spiritual growth is inner healing. Learn how forgiveness, honest inner work and discernment free you from what holds you back.
- [Rung 5: Purpose — finding your gifts, calling and how to serve](https://9nthdimension.com/ladder/purpose/): The fifth stage of spiritual growth is purpose. Learn how to recognise your gifts, discern your calling and turn your growth into service to others.
- [Rung 6: Abiding — living from peace and connection, not effort](https://9nthdimension.com/ladder/abiding/): The sixth stage of spiritual growth is abiding: a steady life lived from peace and connection with God rather than striving. Learn what it looks like and how to stay there.

## Articles

- [What is the Book of Enoch and why isn't it in the Bible?](https://9nthdimension.com/ladder/awakening/what-is-the-book-of-enoch/): 1 Enoch is an ancient Jewish book written in Enoch's name centuries before Jesus. Jude quotes it, but most churches left it out. Here's what it is and why.
- [What to do when prayer feels dry](https://9nthdimension.com/ladder/healing/what-to-do-when-prayer-feels-dry/): Dry prayer is a normal stage of spiritual growth, not a sign that God is gone. Here's why it happens and five practical ways to keep praying through it.
